_comment: The four catalog items the request pipeline works (WD-182), as a template for a ServiceNow administrator: each item's variables, and the fields added to sc_req_item. No item has a free-text command field. Names are examples (x_example_hda); match config/request-items.json if you change them.

requestedItemFields.name: u_automation_state
requestedItemFields.writtenBy: the access management hand-off (ready) and the pipeline (done, failed, manual)

requestedItemFields.name: u_isc_access_request_id
requestedItemFields.writtenBy: the agency's system access management tool, when it submits the request to SailPoint

requestedItemFields.name: u_identity_verified_by
requestedItemFields.writtenBy: the service desk agent who verified the person (resets only)

requestedItemFields.name: u_identity_verification_method
choices: Callback to the phone number in the HR record
In person with a PIV card
Video call with a government ID
Manager confirmation through the HR record

requestedItemFields.name: u_one_time_secret
requestedItemFields.writtenBy: the pipeline only; readable only by the assigned agent's group (servicenow/acl.md); cleared by servicenow/scheduled-job-clear-one-time-secret.js

variables.name: change_id
variables.help: The change; only these can run

variables.name: value
variables.help: The new value; checked against the change's list or pattern

items.name: Cloud account for a partner or lab user

variables.name: user_principal_name
variables.help: first initial and surname, in the cloud-only domain
